title: Note: Heart Piece Location
description: This Piece of Heart is tracked on the [Child Link Map](https://mapgenie.io/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time/maps/child-past?locationIds=1062969) as it can be found early in the game and doesn't require Adult Link. Location: Once you have access to a bomb bag, you can begin to explore Zora River, and you'll find a Cucco wandering around on the other side of a sealed gate past a Bean Seller. Be sure to take the Cucco with you as you continue up the Zora River trail to where the entrance to Zora's Domain is. There are several crossing platforms here. On the other side, a high ledge overlooks a second Piece of Heart on a tiny platform to the northwest. Use that Cucco you held earlier to do one more floating jump across the falls to reach it.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 007 - A Cute, Unusual Visitor
description: - Rumor: "It is said that a new resident has moved into Kokiri Forest..." - Points: 50P - Location - Kokiri Forest: Link's House (Adult Era) - Once you have become an adult, you'll need to rescue Epona and restore Lon Lon Ranch to its former glory. You can then take on Malon's obstacle course, and if you complete the course under the time limit, she'll reward you with a cow that's delivered to Link's home in Kokiri Forest, which will fulfill the rumor location!

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 040 - A Girl's Memories
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a place where you can catch a glimpse of a girl's memories..." - Points: 40P - Location - Lon Lon Ranch (Adult Era): This rumor can be found at Lon Lon Ranch at the center of Hyrule Field. Once on the ranch as an adult, enter the main building on the eastern side and climb to the bedroom on the second floor, and check the left corner for Malon's updated wall of portraits.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 051 - The Shadow Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one blending into the dark night joyfully surrenders to the hammer..." - Points: 20P - Location - Kakariko Village Graveyard: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone hiding at the back of the Graveyard past Kakariko Village. To reach it, you'll need to have learned the Nocturne of Shadow as an adult, and then warp to the entrance to the [Shadow Temple](https://www.ign.com/wikis/ocarina-of-time-remake/Shadow_Temple_Dungeon_Walkthrough "Shadow Temple Dungeon Walkthrough"). Just to the left of the entrance, hit the Gossip Stone with your Megaton Hammer to squash it.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 052 - Gravekeeper's Resting Place
description: - Rumor: "It is said that, at night, something glows eerily..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village Graveyard (Adult Era): This rumor can be found in the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village. Once you're an adult, return to the cemetery to find that a new headstone has been installed -- Dampe's grave -- on the northwestern edge of the graves by a large tree.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 053 - Former Gravekeeper's Diary
description: - Rumor: "It is said that a secret is hidden in an abandoned building..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village Graveyard (Adult Era): This rumor can be found in the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village. Once you've become an adult, return to the cemetery and enter Dampe's old shack to find his journal now on the floor.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 063 - The Rock-Spring Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one lingering at the discovery of spring water flowing in a scorching-hot land joyfully wobbles from side to side..." - Points: 30P - Location - Death Mountain Crater: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone found within a Hidden Hole deep in the crater of Death Mountain (The area will constantly damage you unless you return as an adult with the Goron Tunic). Quickly explore the southwest corner of the crater to find a boulder you can bomb to reveal the Hidden Hole, and inside is a safe spot with the Gossip Stone you can hit with a ranged attack.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 064 - The Flame Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one enduring obscurity in the scorching heat joyfully surrenders to the hammer..." - Points: 20P - Location - Death Mountain Crater: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone deep within the crater of Death Mountain. Return to this area as an adult and look for an alcove to the southeast that you can destroy with a bomb to reveal the Gossip Stone, and hit with the Megaton Hammer.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 077 - The Gate of Silence
description: - Rumor: "It is said that a wall of snow sealed the fairies' secret passage, and they all fled, shivering in the cold." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora Fountain (Adult): This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, and can be found above the Zora Domain at the Zora Fountain where Lord Jabu-Jabu once resided. As an adult, return to the frozen area and look for a large archway ruin along the southern stretch of shallower water for the rumor location.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 082 - Beware of Wild Creatures
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a strange, bloodthirsty creature waiting in deep, dark waters..." - Points: 40P - Location - Lake Hylia (Adult Era): This rumor can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Enter the large Lakeside Laboratory as an adult once you have obtained the Iron Boots in the Ice Cavern, and drop down to the bottom of the lab's pool to approach a barred gate where an angry shark is lurking.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 083 - Weather Vane atop the Tower
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there is a suspicious device that keeps moving even though there's no wind..." - Points: 50P - Location - Lake Hylia (Adult Era): This rumor can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Be sure to plant some Magic Beans in the soft soil in front of the Lakeside Laboratory as a child, then return as an adult to ride to the top of the observatory, where you can find a large weathervane.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 089 - A Meal for Carpenters
description: - Rumor: "They say there is a tantalizing dish that makes you break into a sweat with just one bite and becomes impossible to stop after eating a second bite..." - Points: 30P - Location - Gerudo Valley (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found in the Gerudo Valley on the far west area past Hyrule Field. As an adult, you can cross the broken bridge using Epona or a Longshot, and enter the workers tent to find a pot of stew cooking in the center.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 090 - Today's Cooking Duty
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's a hidden dish that makes you break into a sweat just by smelling it and awakens your entire body with a single taste..." - Points: 40P - Location - Gerudo Fortress (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found at the home of the Gerudo within their fortress, but is best explored after you've gained the Gerudo Pass. Enter the central main doorway from the ground floor and head up the steps down a hallway to the right, then take a left to find a dining area with a large pot in a fireplace along the right side by two Gerudo guards.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 091 - Throne of Schemes
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there's a special chair engraved with a symbol that represents the sun..." - Points: 40P - Location - Gerudo Fortress (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found at the home of the Gerudo within their fortress, but is best explored after you've gained the Gerudo Pass. The easist way to find this room within the fortress is by leaping from the ledge above the prison cell to the upper floor door to the east, and look for a large war room with a massive chair on one side.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 092 - Merciless Iron Door
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's a door that, once walked through, does not allow you to return..." - Points: 40P - Location - Gerudo Fortress (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found at the home of the Gerudo within their fortress, but is best explored after you've gained the Gerudo Pass. The easist way to find this cell door is to get thrown in jail, or hookshot up the vines on the northwest side to drop back down into cell (it can also be reached through the war room with the previous Gossip Rumor.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 093 - Veterans' Allies
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there are those who carry stories of brave Gerudo warriors..." - Points: 30P - Location - Gerudo Fortress (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found at the home of the Gerudo within their fortress, but is best explored after you've gained the Gerudo Pass. You can find this rumor in the large horseback archery course along the southeast path, and the target is located just to the right of the attendant.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 094 - Li'l Miss Moo at the Fortress
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a cow-like horse beloved by a particular Gerudo..." - Points: 30P - Location - Gerudo Fortress (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found at the home of the Gerudo within their fortress, but is best explored after you've gained the Gerudo Pass. You can find this rumor in the large horseback archery course along the southeast path, and the stable with the cow can be found in the southern area near the attendant.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 095 - A Gauging Gaze
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is one who lurks in the scorching heat, gauging the skill of warriors..." - Points: 50P - Location - Gerudo Proving Grounds (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found at the home of the Gerudo within their fortress, but is best explored after you've gained the Gerudo Pass. You can find this rumor in the large southeast of the fortress at the Proving Grounds near the Horseback Archery Course. Once inside, take the left door and keep progressing up through the challenge rooms into a room with several Wolfos, and then use the Lenses of Truth to find a hole through a wall to hookshot through, leading to a large lava-filled room with a rock in the center that has multiple eye targets.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 096 - Sand Tower Altar
description: - Rumor: "It is said that wriggling gold lies near an altar hidden deep within a sandstorm..." - Points: 40P - Location - Mirage Desert (Adult Era): The location of this rumor is hidden deep within the deserts past the Gerudo Fortress, on the way to the [Spirit Temple](https://www.ign.com/wikis/ocarina-of-time-remake/Spirit_Temple_Dungeon_Walkthrough "Spirit Temple Dungeon Walkthrough"). To reach it, you must cross the quicksand with the Longshot, and use the post markers to reach a stone structure with an underground altar.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 097 - A Shop Not on the Map
description: - Rumor: "It is said that numerous witnesses have seen a strange figure floating in a vast mirage..." - Points: 40P - Location - Mirage Desert (Adult Era): The location of this rumor can be found within the vast sandstorms of the Mirage Desert past the Gerudo Fortress. The strange shopkeeper on a floating carpet hides just on the left after passing the quicksand and moving between the first two posts in the sandstorm, and you'll need the Hover Boots to reach him.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 098 - A Drop of Blessing
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's a place where the evil deity's tears fell..." - Points: 40P - Location - Evil Desert Colossus: The location of this rumor can be found on the other side of the Mirage Desert at the site of the Spirit Temple and Evil Desert Colossus. In the region's southern edge is an oasis without water, which you can fill by playing the Song of Storms.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 099 - The Heat-Haze Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one guarding the goddess of the sand joyfully surrenders to the hammer..." - Points: 20P - Location - Evil Desert Colossus: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, and can be found on the other side of the Mirage Desert at the site of the Spirit Temple and Evil Desert Colossus. You'll find the Gossip Stone in a small crevice in the southwestern corner below the large statue, where you can hit it with the Megaton Hammer.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 100 - Witness to War
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a silent witness to the land's rise and fall..." - Points: 30P - Location - Ganondorf's Castle (Adult Era): This rumor location is found at the edge of Ganondorf's Castle beyond the ruined castle town. Once you're an adult, you can explore north of the town to find the edge of a large crater where the new castle floats, and an old dead tree nearby.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: When you're still Child Link, be sure to purchase some Magic Beans from the Bean Seller in Zora River. Then make your way back to the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village, and look for some soft soil by a dead tree on the north side of the graveyard, just below some raised ruins with a Piece of Heart just out of reach. When you return as an adult, the beans will have sprouted into a floating flower, and it will take you directly to the Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Returning to the Kakariko Village Graveyard as an adult, you'll find a new grave by the magic bean plant, where Dampe the Grave-digger's spirit lies, and has built out a race course for you to run. Keep up with him to the finish, and he'll award you the Hookshot. Since you can't go back the way you came, use the Hookshot to zip to a far ledge, and take the passage up to the Windmill. You'll be able to jump across the windmill's moving parts to find a Piece of Heart on a high ledge!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: After you've run Dampe's race in the Graveyard as Adult Link, you'll be able to revisit Dampe and try again. He'll offer a second wager after you've claimed the Hookshot - beat the race in under a minute, and he'll have a new reward for you. To win, keep an eye on the flames he shoots out, make sure to keep sprinting at all times, and memorize the route you need to take. If you're still having trouble, come back with the Longshot from the Water Temple to zip up the last staircase and shave off precious seconds, and you'll win a Piece of Heart.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: To get this Piece of Heart, you need to first be diligent as Child Link in purchasing some Magic Beans and planting them in the right spots. Head to Lake Hylia, and plant some Magic Beans in a patch of soft soil just outside the Observatory. Return when you're an adult, and the beans will have sprouted into a magic floating plant. Let it take you all the way up to the top of the observatory, and climb up the ladder to find a Piece of Heart here.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: To get this Piece of Heart, you need to first be diligent as Child Link in purchasing some Magic Beans and planting them in the right spots. Head up the Death Mountain Trail and look at the entrance to Dodongo Cavern for a patch of soft soil you can plant the seeds in. Return when you're an adult, and the beans will have sprouted into a magic floating plant. Let it take you all the way up to the top of a high ledge where a Piece of Heart has been taunting you.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: This Piece of Heart resides in the burning heart of Death Mountain, atop one of the large rocky pillars in the active volcano. To get this Piece of Heart, you need to first be diligent as Child Link in purchasing some Magic Beans and planting them in the right spots -- but you can't reach this spot until you unlock access to the Fire Temple as Adult Link. Once you do, return back to being Child Link and play the Bolero of Fire to warp outside the temple. Quickly plant the Magic Beans before you light on fire, and then warp back to the Temple of Time. Return as Adult Link, and you'll find a magic floating plant to take you up to the Piece of Heart.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: When Link returns to Zora Fountain as an adult, the entire area will have become an ice field. Carefully hop across the icebergs in the water to reach a Piece of Heart on the northeast corner of the frigid lake.

title: Heart Piece
description: Required: Iron Boots Location: This Piece of Heart can be found in the frozen remains of Zora Fountain. Equip the boots and dive down to the bottom of this lake to find it among a ring of Green Rupees. You'll start taking damage as you run out of air, so it's recommended to unfreeze King Zora first so you can breathe underwater with the Zora Tunic.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: This Piece of Heart is offered by the scientist who lives in the Observatory at Lake Hylia, though you won't be able to claim this prize until you're an adult. He'll challenge you to reach the bottom of the pool in his lab, which requires you diving a total of 9 meters. To do this, you'll need to catch the biggest fish in the nearby Lake Hylia fishing pond as an adult, and get the Golden Scale as a reward. Then dive down into the pool and talk to the scientist to get your reward.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: From the northern rooftops, head south to climb up a crumbling slope to the top southeastern roofs before doubling back to the north. When you find a gap too large to cross, play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre and hookshot across to him. Look just to the left, and you'll find a Treasure Chest holding a Piece of Heart. You can also hookshot the chest directly from the ledge above the jail cell, accessible via the ladder outside the cell.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: This one will require you first completing the area to earn back the trust of the Gerudo people, allowing you to explore the area. Once you can, summon Epona and travel to the archery course on the southeast part of town. You'll need to score over 750 Points by shooting both the pots and large targets to earn a Piece of Heart as your prize.

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: This Piece of Heart can be found far out in the desert past the Gerudo Fortress, at the site of the Spirit Temple at the Evil Desert Colossus. Once you reach this spot as Adult Link, you'll be unable to travel very far, and Sheik will teach you a melody to warp here as Child Link. When you do, bring along some Magic Beans to plant in some soft soil, then return as Adult Link to ride the floating plant over a stone archway with the Piece of Heart on top. Plant will circle around the area before lingering in front of the obelisk gate.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Returning to Kakariko Village once you are an adult, you'll be prompted to investigate the Graveyard and challenge Dampe's ghost to a race, earning the Hookshot as a reward. Return to the village when night falls, and look around the left side of Impa's old house for a clump of vines leading up to a high ledge. You can zip to them with the hookshot, allowing you to reach the stables behind with a cow, and a Gold Skulltula in hiding. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After you've claimed the Hookshot from beating Dampe's Ghost at a race in the Kakariko Village Graveyard, return to Hyrule Castle Town and dodge the Redeads that have overrun the plaza to reach what remains of Hyrule Castle. Now Ganon's Castle, there's not much left of the original castle, but you can find the old archway of the gatehouse. Look around the back side just over the large pit to find a Gold Skulltula hiding high up above, and nab its token with the Hookshot. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Armed with the Hookshot gained from beating Dampe's Ghost Race, return to Kokiri Forest, and clear out the enemies who have moved in. Once night falls (or use the Sun's Song), head around to the back of the Twin's House (the one closest to the tunnel leading to the Great Deku Tree), and you can find a Gold Skulltula hiding high up at the top, and can be hit with the Hookshot. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: When you're still Child Link, be sure to purchase some Magic Beans from the Bean Seller in Zora River. Then head to the Lost Woods entrance, and find a hidden grove by going right, left to the Goron City shortcut, right to the Zora River shortcut, left, and left again. Look for a patch of soft soil by a large tree to plant the beans in. Return once you're an adult, and you can ride a floating plant up to a high ledge where a Gold Skulltula has been waiting for you. Requires: Magic Beans

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: In the large Sacred Grove area past the Lost Woods that leads to the Forest Temple, carefully advance through the narrow paths defeating the Moblins from behind until you reach the large stairway up. Instead, turn around to find an opening in the ruins leading to a Fairy Fountain, as well as a ladder shortcut leading to the top of the ruins you can jump over to quickly head back. As you jump back, check the eastern side near the roots of a large tree for a Gold Skulltula hanging to the high walls, and nab it with your Hookshot. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: In the large entrance room, you'll need to climb a large tree full of vines to reach a key at the top. After climbing up, turn around to spot the Gold Skulltula at the very top of the tree vines to hit with your Hookshot. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider early on. As soon as you reach the main foyer of the Forest Temple where the Poe Sisters disappear with their torches, head directly north up the stairs toward a door with a green stained-glass window. At the top of the stairs, turn to the right toward a blue-tinted window, and you'll find the Gold Skulltula hanging onto the inside of the wall here. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider after you've defeated the first few Poe Sisters and claimed the Fairy Bow. Return to the third floor and shoot the eye above a door leading down a red twisting hallway to straighten the hall out. On the other side, grab the Boss Key and then look for a hole to drop down onto floor 1F. This path will take you out onto a balcony overlooking the northwest outdoor courtyard with the well entrance. Before exiting the balcony, carefully walk along the ledge to the south past a door, and around a corner to find a Gold Skulltula up here. Requires: Hookshot, Fairy Bow

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider after you've defeated the first few Poe Sisters and claimed the Fairy Bow. Once you have enough Small Keys, head up to the third floor and go down the twisting red hallway, through the Poe Sister Rooms and to the end of the straight blue hallway, where you can unfreeze an eye target to twist the blue hallway. This will open up a pit to drop back down to floor 1F, and the path here will lead you out onto a ledge above the northeast outdoor courtyard. You can push a block here for a shortcut, but if you look up above, you can spot some gusting wind. You'll need to play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre, and then hookshot up to the high ledge using the scarecrow to find the Gold Skulltula up here. Requires: Hookshot, Fairy Bow, Scarecrow's Song

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Forest Temple during the Adult Link timeline, you can find this spider after you've defeated the all four Poe Sisters and unlocked the elevator to the basement. As soon as you arrive in B1, turn around and look for a small room to the south. It's guarded by a Skulltula, but after defeating it you can walk into the room and look to the right to find a Gold Skulltula as well. If the way is blocked, just keep pushing the handholds around to open the room to open up access to the southern alcove. Requires: Hookshot, Fairy Bow

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: There's a tricky Gold Skulltula hiding in Hyrule Field, but the process to uncover it will involve a bit of time travel. Because of this, its easier to do after completing the Forest Temple, when you can freely swap between Child and Adult Era. As Child Link, head to the southeast part of Hyrule Field in a small wetland area with several large Peahats. Near one of the Peahats is a cracked stone on the ground you can bomb to reveal a Grotto. Inside, you can find fairy writing that urges you to destroy the regular Skullwalltula here. After doing this, take the Master Sword and become Adult Link, and return to the Grotto. With the Skullwalltula gone, a Gold Skulltula will have taken its place.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: There's only one Gold Skulltula hiding in an early dungeon you'll first explore a child, but can only claim the token as an adult. Once you've become Adult Link and gained the Hookshot, head to Lake Hylia to learn the Scarecrow Song, and then head up the Death Mountain Trail to re-enter Dodongo Cavern. Take the pathway off the main entrance hall to the first hallway to the east where you encounter some Baby Dodongos. Nearby you'll find a high ledge with gusting wind, and you can play the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre. Hookshot up to him, and you can claim the Gold Skulltula token. Requires: Hookshot, Scarecrow Song

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Upon returning to Goron City as Adult Link, you'll find a new Gold Skulltula hiding in the city when night falls outside. Drop down from the highest ring to one level below, and move around to the back of the high central platform that used to hold the Spiritual Stone of Fire. At the back of the rock jutting downward, you'll find a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, you can find this spider early on in your exploration. Soon after entering, head from the entrance hall to the eastern room, a large area filled with lava and moving platforms. Make your way to the top northeast corner of the room to find a high ledge with a large blue block you can use the Song of Time to move out of the way. Head through the door and fend of Flying Tiles and a Like Like to find a Gold Skulltula in the back of the room.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, you can find this spider early on in your exploration. After creating a lift up to floor 3F, you'll enter a large room full of rolling boulders on the eastern side of the map. Hop down and avoid the boulders as you make your way along the walls to the north. Look for a cracked wall, and bomb it to reveal a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Bombs

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, this spider is one of two you can find after you've explored the large eastern room on 3F on both sides, and raced the fire wall to a high ledge leading back to the upper platforms of the room with the rolling boulders. Jump to the first platform and turn around to see a gust of wind on a high ledge above, and play the Scarecrow Song to reveal Pierre. Hookshot up to him, and look for a nearby platform to hookshot to, taking you up to floor 4F, at the top of the mesh walls by the door to floor 5F, you'll find a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Hookshot, Scarecrow's Song

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, this spider is one of two you can find after you've explored the large eastern room on 3F on both sides, and raced the fire wall to a high ledge leading back to the upper platforms of the room with the rolling boulders. Jump to the first platform and turn around to see a gust of wind on a high ledge above, and play the Scarecrow Song to reveal Pierre. Hookshot up to him, and look for a nearby platform to hookshot to, taking you up to floor 5F. After you enter the large circular room, look along the inner wall over a lava pit to spot the Gold Skulltula. Requires: Hookshot, Scarecrow's Song

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that are hiding within the Fire Temple, you can find this spider after acquiring the Megaton Hammer within the dungeon. Once you have the special item, return to the entrance hall, and knock aside a statue blocking a door in the lower right corner. Follow the hall to a room with several Flying Tiles and a Like Like, and then destroy the large rock at the back of the room to reveal a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Megaton Hammer

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After obtaining the Megaton Hammer from the Fire Temple, return to the Death Mountain Trail's summit by the Great Fairy Fountain. Head back down the trail path wall toward Goron City, and look for a large grey rock you can destroy with the hammer, revealing a Gold Skulltula at night. Requires: Megaton Hammer

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After obtaining the Megaton Hammer from the Fire Temple, exit Goron City and look for a large grey rock by where the lone Bomb Flower used to be. Destroy the rock with the hammer, and at night you'll find a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Megaton Hammer

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Head up the Zora River as Adult Link, and either use the floating magic plant from the beans you planted as a child, or use a Cucco to get to the top of the large island in the middle of the river. Along its south side, you can find a crossing to a high ledge, and near it, a Gold Skulltula will appear at night in range of your Hookshot. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Head up the Zora River as Adult Link, and make your way to the top of the river where the falls conceal the entrance to Zora's Domain. Look back to the west as you reach this area, and there will be a Gold Skulltula at night hanging from the high walls in range of your hookshot. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Upon entering Zora's Domain as an adult, you'll find the entire place has frozen, including the large waterfall. Just next to the waterfall and to the left of the stairs leading to the audience chamber is a Gold Skulltula, and you can head to the top of the frozen waterfall to reach it by aiming left from the ledge. Requires: Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Required: Hookshot Location: In the first large room with a pair of spinning scythes where you need to collect 5 silver gems. Carefully move around the blades and look up at the southern wall to find the Gold Skulltula.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Required: Hookshot, Blue Fire (Bottled) Location: One of a few Gold Skulltulas that is hiding in the Ice Cavern mini-dungeon atop Zora Fountain. You can find this one after you find the first font of Blue Fire. Take a bottle and burn away the red ice above the room with the two spinning scythes to find a passage to the east. At the end of this hall, look behind a large icy pillar right next to the Treasure Chest with the Compass inside.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of a few Gold Skulltulas that is hiding in the Ice Cavern mini-dungeon atop Zora Fountain. You can find this one after you find the first font of Blue Fire. Take a bottle and burn away the red ice blocking the path to the west in the room with the two spinning scythes. This leads to an area with a block-sliding puzzle, and once you jump across to the icy ground, look back the way you came to spot a Gold Skulltula on a low wall. Requires: Hookshot, Blue Fire

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: There's a Golden Skulltula hiding in the Observatory at Lake Hylia, though you won't be able to claim this prize until you're an adult. Once you've obtained the Iron Boots from the Ice Cavern above Zora Fountain, return to Lake Hylia and equip the boots to drop to the bottom of the pool in the lab. There's a crate down here (and a surprise!) and you can roll into it to reveal a Gold Skulltula, which you can defeat with your Hookshot. Requires: Iron Boots, Zora Tunic

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one shortly after raising the water level up to floor 2F in the main central pillar building at the entrance. Once you have, return to the bottom floor of the pillar room to find an opening to the basement B1 now that a floating block has gone up. Hit a green switch with your Hookshot to reveal a hatch and climb up to find a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Hookshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Y can find this one shortly after raising the water level up to floor 2F in the main central pillar building at the entrance. Once you have, return to the eastern room on floor 1F, where you first met Princess Ruto, and float up to a ledge with a cracked wall. Destroy the wall with a bomb to find a room with three Shell Blades, and a Gold Skulltula hiding in the corner. Requires: Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Bombs

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: You can find this one shortly after gaining the Longshot by defeating Shadow Link. Once you have the Longshot, you can drop down into a long cavern with a raging river on floor 2F leading back to the main room. The cavern has many twists and is full of whirlpools, and once the path curves south, turn around and look up above the water for a Gold Skulltula on a high rocky outcropping you can reach with the Longshot while underwater. Requires: Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that hide in the puzzling Water Temple, you can find this one shortly after gaining the Longshot by defeating Shadow Link. Once you have the Longshot, return to the central room with the tall pillar room when the water is down to the first level. Enter the base of the pillar room and work your way up to raise the level up one floor, then look upward for hookshot targets to reach the top of the room with, and you'll find a Gold Skulltulla along the ceiling that can be reached with the Longshot. Requires: Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Find this one just before reaching the Boss Key Chest. Once you have the Longshot, you can begin to explore the series of rooms in the north of the central room on Floor 1F. This will lead you to an area with narrow flooded paths that rolling boulders continually pass through. Look up at the middle pit the boulders fall down from to find a Gold Skulltulla opposite the waterfall. Requires: Iron Boots, Zora Tunic, Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once you have beaten the Water Temple and collected the Longshot, you'll return to the island in the middle of Lake Hylia with a giant tree on it. Turn day to night with the Sun's Song, and look for a patch of vines near the top of the tree you can reach with your Longshot, and the Gold Skulltula can be found at the top. Requires: Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B3. After crossing several platforms of falling guillotines and defeating a Stalfos, take a left to head east using the Hover Boots to cross a gap with invsible platforms. Defeat all the enemies in the next room with an invisible spinning scythe trap to unlock the far door where a Gold Skulltula is waiting. Requires: Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B3. After crossing several platforms of falling guillotines and defeating a Stalfos, take a right to head west to an area with five silver rupees that unlock a new door. In the next room, pull out a stone block and use it to get through the falling spike traps and then pull it to the far side to climb up. On the upper wall back the way you came, you can spot a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Shadow Temple once you've claimed the Lenses of Truth from the Bottom of the Well, you'll need to advance through the dungeon until reaching the basement floor B3. Make your way around to the north by solving both silver rupee puzzles, until you reach a series of narrow corridors with wind statues pushing you back. When you reach a gap you'll need to cross with the Hover Boots before the wind starts up again, look instead down the pit to spy a Gold Skulltula just below you, and shoot it once you cross to the far side. Requires: Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Basement floor B4. Upon reaching the area with the large docked skeletal ship, there's a large cage with a block you can pull out for a shortcut back to floor B1. Atop the cage, look for a gust of straw and play the Scarecrow Song to summon Pierre. You can hookshot to him, and find the Gold Skulltula on a nearby wall. Requires: Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots, Scarecrow Song

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Basement floor B4. Ride the skeletal ship to the far western side of the dungeon, and then head through to a room full of invisible maze-like walls. Make your way to the far west room where three large spinning Black Skulls are. Toss a bomb in each, and one will explode to reveal a Gold Skulltula inside. Requires: Lenses of Truth, Hover Boots, Bombs

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once you've become Adult Link, there's a few Golden Skulltulas that will appear in Gerudo Valley. To reach it, you'll either need to gallop across the broken bridge with Epona, or gain access to the Longshot. However you do, look for the new carpenter's tent on the other side once it's nightfall, and you'll find some ruins behind it with a Gold Skulltula on the wall. Requires: Longshot or Epona

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once you've become Adult Link, there's a few Golden Skulltulas that will appear in Gerudo Valley. To reach it, you'll either need to gallop across the broken bridge with Epona, or gain access to the Longshot. However you do, search the southern area opposite the carpenter's camp for a series of large rocks you can destroy with the Megaton Hammer. However, if you look upward on the inside of a natural stone arch, you'll find a Gold Skulltula here at night. Requires: Longshot or Epona

title: Gold Skulltula

Once you do, look for a fortress entrance up on a high level in the northeast, adorned with red fabric. On a high wall to the right of the doorway you can find a Gold Skulltula at night. Requires: Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Take Epona over to the horseback archery training course at night, and ride to the top northeast corner. Look around the back of the large target place high in the air, and you'll find a Gold Skulltula hiding here. Requires: Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Past the guarded Gerudo Fortress, you can find a Gold Skulltula all the way out in the middle of the Mirage Desert. You'll need to carefully cross the line of quicksand, and then follow the markers until you reach a ruin to take shelter in. Look for a ladder down away from the sands, and in a small chamber you can find the Gold Skulltula. Requires: Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After you've crossed the Mirage Desert past Gerudo Fortress, you'll arrive at the Evil Desert Colossus where the Spirit Temple is. Use the Sun's Song to turn day to night, then check the northern cliffs of this area where some Guay gather in flocks, and you can also find a Gold Skulltula along the walls. Requires: Longshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After you've crossed the Mirage Desert past Gerudo Fortress, you'll arrive at the Evil Desert Colossus where the Spirit Temple is. Once you try to enter as Adult Link, you'll find that only Child Link can fit in a tunnel, prompting Sheik to teach you the melody to warp here. Return as Child Link and bring some Magic Beans with you. There's a patch of soft soil just by the left of the entrance you can plant the beans in. Return as Adult Link and once night has fallen, ride the magic floating plant to a large raised plateau in the northeast, where a Gold Skulltula is hiding out of view. Requires: Magic Beans

title: Gold Skulltula

One can be found after opening the door from the entrance hall to the northeast, leading you to a half-pipe room filled with rolling boulders. Check along the left side past a blue block for an open alcove hiding a Gold Skulltula. If you've played the Song of Time to get to the Silver Rupee, you'll need to play it again to remove the block from the alcove with the Skulltula. Requires: Silver Gauntlets

Play the Scarecrow Song to summon Pierre, and hookshot over to locate a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Silver Gauntlets, Longshot, Scarecrow's Song

Head all the way to the top, and turn around to find the Gold Skulltula.

title: Phantom Ganon
description: How to defeat: Watch the riders appearing in the paintings closely. When they reach the edge of the painting, the clones will turn back, as the real Phantom Ganon will leap through the painting. If you aren't quick enough to pin down the real one, he'll soar over the arena and slash down this his lightning spear, sending shockwaves of light across the floor that can be tough to dodge. If you remember at the start of the fight, Phantom Ganon was wielding his spear in his right hand. His clones however, will be holding the spear in their left hand, showing on the right side of the painting as you watch them approach. Focus instead only on the one holding his spear out to the left side of the painting, and fire away when he draws close. After getting a few shots with your Fairy Bow in, Phantom Ganon will start getting more clever, adding a second, and then third clone to keep you swiveling. The trick for spotting the fakes still stands, but you'll need to pan the camera quickly to zero in on which one is the real Phantom Ganon before firing your bow. Once you've hit him around 2-3 times with your bow, Phantom Ganon will leave his horse behind, signaling phase two of this fight. He'll instead opt to float high ahove you, doing away with his clones for a 1 v 1 fight! You can slash your own sword when the orb draws near to send it back to Phantom Ganon imbuing the orb with light from the Master Sword. When he holds his spear up high for a big slash, he'll send it back quicker. You'll need to be just as quick, and get the orb back in his face before he can recover from the swing. This will stun him with his own energy blast, and he'll fall to the ground in a weakened state. Race on over to his position as he falls to hit him with jump attacks and spin attacks to maximize your damage until he can recover. Repeat.

title: Volvagia
description: How to defeat: When the battle starts, the Subterranean Lava Dragon will emerge from one of these nearby lava pools, whipping its fiery mane around, and then emitting a blast of fire from its maw. As soon as you see an opening, race forward and make a jumping leap attack with your new Megaton Hammer. You'll be able to smash apart the helm Volvagia wears, stunning it and allowing to strike at the crack on the dragon's forehead. Volvagia will emit a beam of fiery breath as it glides across the arena leaving a trail of fire in its wake. Always dash perpendicular to its attack route to avoid the flames! These fire trails will leave lasting smouldering spots along the arena, so take care to avoid them as Volvagia returns to the lava tunnels to make its next ambush. At this point, it will try and fake you out by causing several lava opening to bubble up. Don't fall for the first few rumblings, but keep yourself close to the next couple so you can close the distance fast. If you take too long to get over to Volvagia next appearance, you'll end up taking a face-full of fire before you can ready your Megaton Hammer. Avoid the falling fiery boulders the dragon triggers and keep repeating the attack loop. In its final aerial assault, it will opt to blanket part of the arena in a fiery trail not once but twice, so be ready to keep moving and watch the smoldering spots. If you're quick, you can even get off a shot or two from your bow as Volvagia prepares for its fly-by. With one more wack to the head, you should be able to deliver the killing blow.

title: Dark Link
description: How to defeat: Dark Link -- a mini-boss -- is a nearly exact copy of Link, but filled with evil magic. This means he can match you in a lot of ways, and yet still surprise you if you aren't careful, so take this fight very seriously! Using his own version of the Master Sword, Dark Link will usually perform three hit slashes, with the last attack in his combo having a red trail on. This is one of the main points you need to remember on when to counter-attack, as dodging that last slash will leave Dark Link open for several moments. Don't try and get pushy with your own moves, as he can deflect them all with his Hylian Shield. Get too sloppy, and Dark Link can even stand on your sword when you try to stab. If you don't shake him off fast, he'll deal a damaging slash as he jumps off. It is possible to catch him off guard with Din's Fire early on, which can not only deal damage but stun him for a moment and let you press the attack. The moment he launches his spin attack is the time to race up for your own jump slash. Don't try to match his spin attacks with your own as you'll almost always be too late. Instead, focus entirely on watching for his jump attacks or spins to find a spot to get in and counter with some damage before backing off.

title: Morpha
description: How to defeat: Somewhat similar to the Flare Dancers of the Fire Temple, the actual body you need to target is the strange little core that hides in the elongated goopy creature you see before you. And just like those Flare Dancers, your Longshot will be key to exposing its weak point! Keep targeting it and pulling it out, then slash away at it.

title: Bongo Bongo
description: Location: Drop into the arena to fight Bongo Bongo. Wear Hover Boots to counter being tossed in the air. Bongo Bongo can't be damaged when its glowing purple. Use the Bow to stun both of its hands after they strike. Activate the Lenses to reveal its eye, then shoot the eye with an arrow. Rush forward and strike its stunned eye with the Master or Biggoron Sword. Repeat until defeated. Collect the Heart Container before entering the blue warp to receive the Shadow Medallion.

title: Twinrova
description: Sorceress Sisters Link's weapons cannot hurt the two sisters, Kotake and Koume. Instead, he needs to use the reflective power of his Mirror Shield to deflect their elemental beams back at them. Fire against ice and ice against fire. In the second phase, Link needs to store the energy of three consecutive attacks from the same element to cause damage, then run in close and use his melee weapon of choice.

title: Ganondorf
description: How to defeat: Return Ganondorf's energy ball by hitting it with your sword, but dodge his multi-projectile and lightning attacks. When he is hit by his own energy ball, he will be stunned. You can shoot him with a Light Arrow and run in close and attack with your sword. He will eventually change the shape of the arena by making certain platforms fall. Stay on the outer platforms, but use the Hookshot to get in close by aiming at the climbable grates to close in and attack when he's stunned.

title: Ganon
description: How to defeat: Sprint past him and use the Megaton Hammer to slam on Ganon's glowing crystal tail. As Ganon gets more enraged, he'll leap into the sky to change position to face you when you try to attack from the rear. This is your cue to back off and seek cover, as his large slam affects an area around him that you don't want to be in range of. In the second phase, Ganon's attacks are stronger and more wilder, and you'll have to instead focus your assault on his arms, which is dangerous when you remember they happen to be holding some very big swords. Ganon can now charge up power by holding his blade close, creating wells of magic along the ground that explode in lightning moments before he slams his own blade down in a vertical swing. You'll need to wait out the explosions while strafing his attack, then run in when the coast is clear to jump slash at his exposed arms! Don't wait around, his the force of his slamming attack will cause more lightning all around his blade. When you see him raising his blade high to the side and the ground in front of him electrifies, keep your distance from his two slashes until the explosions stop. If you're having trouble closing the distance, know that you can also fire more Light Arrows at his exposed arms, but you want to wait for a moment where his arms aren't constantly moving, so pick your shots carefully since you don't want to be wasting ammo and magic power! After slicing up both of his arms enough to remove the undulating power within, he'll fall to the ground... only for the Triforce of Power to overload within him, sending him into a crazed assault! Princess Zelda will call out that she's ready to help expose him, but it will take a few moments for her to prepare her spell. Keep strafing and sprinting along the edges of the arena to keep him at a distance. To fully bring this Demon King down, you'll need to utilize Zelda's gift to its fullest extent. Wait for an opening after his wild slashes and slams, and let a Light Arrow fly straight into his exposed eye.

Inside is a peculiar Deku Business Scrub, who won't trade with you unless you know the password. To get the password, you'll have to become Adult Link, and return to the Grotto entrance. Nearby on a tree, you can now find fairy writing which has the password. Unfortunately, as an adult, the Scrub has already sold his wares. Once you complete the Forest Temple, return to being Child Link, and use the password on the Scrub to buy his Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees!

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 019 - Someone's Cart
description: - Rumor: "It is said that fairies are drawn to hard workers..." - Points 30P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location can be found in the northeast corner of the large field map, right below the stairs leading up to Kakariko Village. title: Gossip Quest Rumor 018 - Zora River Bridge
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a bridge built to keep visitors' feet dry..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location can be found in the northeast corner of the large field map, where a bridge connects the road from Hyrule Castle toward Kakariko Village, over the river that flows from Zora River.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 017 - Hyrule Royal Family's Stone Marker
description: - Rumor: "It is said that a stone slab associated with the royal family lies in a place where remnants of castle walls stand..." - Points: 40P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location is located on the northern edge of the field, right in front of the drawbridge entrance to Hyrule Castle Town. A large stone signpost can be found in front of the road to Lon Lon Ranch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 016 - The Sage's Perch
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a place where those who possess wisdom descend..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location can be found just outside the entrance to Kokiri Forest. At the forest entrance is a large tree with a branch sticking out where you first meet Kaepora Gaebora on the eastern side of the field.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 026 - Overindulgent Guy
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is the laziest Hylian in Hyrule..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town (Child Era): This rumor location can be found in the alleys of Castle Town. Search the far northwest corner past the Shooting Gallery to find a man lying down in the corner of the alley before the Treasure Chest Shop.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 027 - A Mother's House
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there is a house built for a dog somewhere..." - Points: 40P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town (Child Era): This rumor location can be found in the alleys of Castle Town. Search along the southwestern part of the alleyway just past the Bombchu shop to find a door with a front window that looks like a paw, and you'll find the home of the lady and her prized dog, Richard.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 025 - Rules for Target Practice
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's something that offers rules for playing..." - Points: 40P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town (Child Era): This rumor location can be found at the Castle Town, inside the Shooting Gallery during the daytime when the business is open. It is located in the northwest side of the town square, opposite from the Happy Mask Shop.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 024 - Mask Shop Information Board
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's a sign with some incredibly strange writing..." - Points: 40P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town (Child Era): This rumor location can be found at the Castle Town, inside the Happy Mask Shop during the daytime when the business is open. It is located in the northeast side of the town square, just before the path to the Temple of Time.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 023 - Fancy Sign
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a fancy sign crafted by a tough-looking person..." - Points: 40P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town (Child Era): This rumor location can be found in the Castle Town area's town square, and is located at the sign post outside the Bazaar shop on the town's eastern side, south of the Happy Mask Shop.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 034 - The Royal Garden Fountain
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a spring imbued with a wish for peace..." - Points: 40P - Location - Hyrule Castle (Child Era): This rumor can be found near the entrance to Hyrule Castle's grounds. Climb over the gatehouse and sneak past the guards to find a large central fountain, staying along the south side to avoid the gaze of its guards.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 008 - Kids' Favorite
