title: Gossip Quest Rumor 009 - A Kid's Favorite
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a secluded forest, far from civilization, where the playful sound of a flute echoes..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lost Woods: From the entrance to the Lost Woods, take the first tunnel to the left. This leads to a forest clearing with a high tree trunk on which a Skull Kid plays the flute, and is the site of the rumor's location.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 010 - The Lost Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one beckoning the lost joyfully bounces up and down..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lost Woods: From the entrance to the Lost Woods, take the first tunnel to the left, past a forest clearing and into the next tunnel, which overlooks the bridge to Hyrule Field. On the far side of this ravine you can find the quest location, taking the form of a Gossip Stone, which you must strike with your weapon to complete.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 011 - The Inviting Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one who guides travelers to the recesses of a deep forest joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 20P - Location - Sacred Grove: Once in the Sacred Grove past the Lost Woods, head to the end of the maze and then turn around before the long stairs to find a ladder up to the top of the ruins. Jump back across south to find the rumor location in the form of a Gossip Stone, and use Din's FIre to make it spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 012 - Old Man of the Grove
description: - Rumor: "It is said that within the Sacred Grove, there is a life that is drawing to a close..." - Points: 30P - Location - Sacred Grove: Once in the Sacred Grove past the Lost Woods, head to the end of the maze and then turn around before the long stairs to find a ladder up to the top of the ruins. Jump back across south and look along the east side for a broken tree along the edge of the platforms.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 013 - The Hospitable Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one who welcomes guests in the deep forest joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 20P - Location - Sacred Grove: Once in the Sacred Grove past the Lost Woods, head to the end of the maze and then turn around before the long stairs to find a ladder up to the top of the ruins. Jump back across south and look along the west side to find the rumor location in the form of a Gossip Stone, and use Din's Fire to make it spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 014 - The Sanctuary Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one watching over the sanctuary joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 20P - Location - Sacred Grove: At the far end of the Sacred Grove where Saria plays her ocarina in front of the Forest Temple entrance, you can find this rumor location in the form of a Gossip Stone, and you can plant a bomb to make it launch into the air.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 015 - The Watcher Awaiting the Sound of Footsteps
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one who awaits visitors in the sanctuary that light cannot reach joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 30P - Location - Sacred Grove: Once you have learned the Song of Time by obtaining the Ocarina of Time, return to the entrance to the Forest Temple where Saria plays her ocarina, and you can find a Hidden Hole in the corner you can open with a bomb. Inside, play the Song of Time to remove the blue blocks to reveal the rumor's location in the form of a Gossip Stone that you can light with Din's Fire to make spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 020 - The Horse-Loving Watcher
description: - Rumor "It is said that one listening carefully to the sounds of horse hooves from the depths of the earth joyfully jump to the skies..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location takes the form of a Gossip Stone inside a Hidden Hole Grotto in Hyrule Field. It can be found in the southeast area of the field below Lon Long Ranch, in a wetland guarded by Peahats. You'll need to bomb open the Hidden Hole entrance and then use another bomb on the Gossip Stone so that it launches into the air.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 021 - The Watcher Held Captive by Spiders
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one held captive by spiders in the depths still joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location takes the form of a Gossip Stone inside a Hidden Hole Grotto in Hyrule Field. It can be found in the far western area of the field just outside the entrance to Gerudo Valley, surrounded by a ring of small rocks. You'll need to bomb open the Hidden Hole entrance and then use Din's Fire on the Gossip Stone so that it spins and stretches.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 022 The Gossip-Loving Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one listening carefully for gossip from the depths of the earth joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Field: This rumor location takes the form of a Gossip Stone inside a Hidden Hole Grotto in Hyrule Field. It can be found in the far eastern area of the field just north of the entrance to Kokiri Forest, next to a small cliffside camp site and pool of water. You'll need to bomb open the Hidden Hole entrance and then use Din's Fire on the Gossip Stone so that it spins and stretches.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 028 - The Delight-Speaking Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one who speaks of quiet delight joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 20P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town: This rumor location takes the form of one of four Gossip Stones on the edge of the Castle Town, in the small garden in front of the Temple of Time. Use Din's Fire on the rightmost Gossip Stone to make it spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 029 - The Joy-Speaking Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one speaking of quiet joy joyfully jumps to the sky..." - Points: 20P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town: This rumor location takes the form of one of four Gossip Stones on the edge of the Castle Town, in the small garden in front of the Temple of Time. Use a bomb on the center right Gossip Stone to make it explode into the sky.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 030 - The Sorrow-Speaking Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one speaking of quiet sorrow joyfully wobbles from side to side..." - Points: 20P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town: This rumor location takes the form of one of four Gossip Stones on the edge of the Castle Town, in the small garden in front of the Temple of Time. Use your Slingshot on the center left Gossip Stone to make it wobble.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 031 - The Anger-Speaking Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one speaking of quiet anger joyfully surrenders to the hammer..." - Points: 20P - Location - Hyrule Castle Town (Child Era): This rumor location takes the form of one of four Gossip Stones on the edge of the Castle Town, in the small garden in front of the Temple of Time. Once you've become an adult and completed the Fire Temple, use your Hammer on the leftmost Gossip stone to flatten it.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 032 - The Evaluating Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one taking stock of the royal family's guests joyfully wobbles from side to side..." - Points: 20P - Location - Hyrule Castle (Child Era): This rumor location takes the form of a Gossip Stone at the entrance to the Hyrule Castle Grounds. Located just before the large gatehouse, you can find the Gossip Stone above a small stream and hit it with your Slingshot to make it wobble.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 035 - The Wisteria-Trellis Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that one gazing at the wisteria flowers joyfully bounces up and down..." - Points: 20P - Location - Hyrule Castle (Child Era): This rumor location takes the form of a Gossip Stone that can be found along the Hyrule Castle grounds. To reach it, you'll need to get over the gatehouse, and evade the guards to sneak through the gardens to reach some stairs at the western side. Attack the Gossip Stone with your sword at the top of the stairs to make it bounce.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 036 - The Hidden-Stone Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that an observer unknown to even those of the royal family joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 30P - Location - Hyrule Castle (Child Era): This rumor location takes the form of a Gossip Stone located in a Hidden Hole at the end of the Hyrule Castle grounds. To reach it, you'll first need to learn the Song of Storms as an adult and return as a child, evading the guards to reach the inner moat near where you met Talon. Play the Song of Storms to reveal the Hidden Hole and drop down, using a bomb to reveal the Gossip Stone, and plant a bomb on it to make it fly into the sky.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 037 - A Guide to the Wind
description: - Rumor: "It is said that giant whirling blades exist on the plains..." - Points: 40P - Location - Lon Lon Ranch: This rumor can be found at Lon Lon Ranch at the center of Hyrule Field. Once on the ranch, move around to the northeastern side to find a tall windmill platform bordering the side garden and main race track.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 038 - Ranch Water Tower
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a place where life-giving water is held..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lon Lon Ranch: This rumor can be found at Lon Lon Ranch at the center of Hyrule Field. Once on the ranch, move around to the northwestern side to find a small farm plot area behind the stables where a wooden water tower is located.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 039 - Malanya
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a being that is a horse-- and yet, not a horse..." - Points: 40P - Location - Lon Lon Ranch (Child Era): This rumor can be found at Lon Lon Ranch at the center of Hyrule Field. Once on the ranch as a child, enter the main building on the eastern side and climb to the bedroom on the second floor, and check the left corner for a giant stuffed horse plush.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 041 - Spirit of Hospitality
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a note from Impa expressing her hospitality..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor can be found right at the entrance to Kakariko Village, where you'll find a large banner over an archway inviting you into the village.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 042 - The Carpenter's Best Friend
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's something called a 'carpenter's best friend.'." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village (Child Era): This rumor can be found just after entering Kakariko Village as a child, and heading up the northern slope above the main plaza, where you'll find a stack of tools just below the stairs heading up to the Death Mountain Trail.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 043 - An Unnamed Master
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a one-of-a-kind special Cucco..." - Points: 40P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor can be found on the northern side of Kakariko Village, up the first small stairway above the main plaza leading toward the gate to Death Mountain. Look around the side of the residential home (where the boy from the graveyard lives), and you'll find his drawings and a sign for a Cucco around the corner of the building.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 044 - A Witness of the Sheikah
description: - Rumor: "It is said that a Sheikah relic remains..." - Points: 40P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor can be found on the northern side of Kakariko Village. Just above the large red-roof home is an old watchtower near the potion shop under construction.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 045 - Weather-Vane Bird
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a cucco watching over the village..." - Points: 40P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor can be found on the northern side of Kakariko Village. Just up the slope leading toward the Death Mountain gate, look for a ladder by the watchtower to climb to the top of the large red-roof building, and you can find a cucco-shaped weather-vane.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 046 - Cursed Mansion
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a house haunted by spiders..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor can be found on the southeastern side of the village, at the large lone house below the Windmill, which is covered in cobwebs, and is home to the Cursed Spider House.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 047 - The Bee Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one surrounded by a dangerously sweet scent joyfully spins and stretches" - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone found within a secret Hidden Hole in the village. Using a bomb, you can open the grotto on the east side of the Cursed Spider House, and inside is where you'll find the Gossip Stone, which you can burn with Din's Fire to make spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 048 - The Reclusive Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one hiding in a Sheikah village joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone found in a Hidden Hole Grotto within the village. To reach it, you'll need to grab a wayward Cucco, and leap from the outside of the Windmill ledge over the large fence, where you'll find the grotto under the abandoned shop.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 049 - Gravekeeper's Diary
description: - Rumor: "It is said that someone's secrets lie hidden where souls rest..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village Graveyard: This rumor can be found in the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village. During the night, once Dampe the Gravedigger is out patrolling, you can enter his shack to find his diary on a table.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 050 - The Grave Where Flat the Younger Rests
description: - Rumor: "It is said that a composer who has lingering feelings for this world wanders around..." - Points: 30P - Location - Kakariko Village Graveyard: This rumor can be found in the Graveyard behind Kakariko Village. Head to the very back of the cemetery to find the Tomb of the Royal Family, and inspect the harp-shaped headstone on the right to find the resting place of Flat the Younger.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 054 - Warm Welcome to Goron City
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a pointy sign in a hot spot..." - Points: 30P - Location - Goron City: This rumor can be found right inside the entrance to Goron City (not to be confused with the identical archway on the outside of the Death Mountain Trail. As soon as you enter the Goron City, turn around and look up to spot the sign.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 055 - The Blacksmith Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one guarding the immovable one joyfully bounces up and down..." - Points: 20P - Location - Goron City: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone located within Goron City. Once you have earned the Goron Bracelet from Darunia, head to the right from the city entrance to a hall blocked by cracked walls you can destroy with Bomb Flowers, leading to Medigoron's room that has the Gossip Stone you can attack with your sword to bounce.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 056 - Ruby Pedestal
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the Goron treasure is being targeted..." - Points: 30P - Location - Goron City: This rumor can be found at the center of Goron City on Death Mountain. From the top outer ring where the entrance is, look for the bridge planks that lead to a center platform where the Spiritual Stone of Fire is normally kept.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 057 - Dancing Vessel
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a giant Goron with three faces..." - Points: 30P - Location - Goron City (Child Era): This rumor can be found at the center of Goron City in Death Mountain. As a child, there will be a large stone pot in the bottom of the city's center with three Goron faces on it.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 058 - The Goron Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the keen-eyed one lingering among the Gorons joyfully surrenders to the hammer..." - Points: 20P - Location - Goron City: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone that can be found on the western side of the city in a large quarry room. You can find this room on the top level, and the path to the Gossip Stone is blocked by several boulders you can bomb or bash with the Megaton Hammer. Hit the Gossip Stone with a hammer to solve the rumor.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 059 - The Meal Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one expressing interest in rock roast joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 20P - Location - Dodongo Cavern: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone hiding within the Dodongo Cavern dungeon along the Death Mountain Trail. Once you've used the Bomb Flowers to enter the dungeon, head to the east side of the main room with the giant skull, and use a Bomb Flower to blow up the cracked wall at the top northeast section, and bomb the Gossip Stone inside to send it soaring.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 060 - The Cow-Protecting Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one watching over a traveler wandering about in the dark joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 30P - Location - Death Mountain Trail: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone that can be found in a Hidden Hole Grotto along the Death Mountain Trail. To reach it, you'll need to use bombs on the path toward the summit, and listen for the sound of a cow coming from below a boulder at the top of a series of ledges. Bomb it to reveal the grotto, and use Din's Fire on the Gossip Stone inside to make it spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 061 - The Throat of the Fire Dragon
description: - Rumor: "It is said that beyond the throat of the fire dragon, one will consumed by scorching heat..." - Points: 30P - Location - Death Mountain Trail: This rumor can be found on the upper path along the Death Mountain Trail toward the high summit. You'll need to use bombs to carve a path up the mountain, and then run up a long slope where fiery rocks can rain down from above to find a large natural archway where the rumor is located.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 062 - The Mountain-Climbing Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one escaping the rain of volcanic rocks joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 20P - Location - Death Mountain Trail: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone that can be found near the end of the upper Death Mountain Trail right before reaching the summit. You'll find this Gossip Stone on a high ledge up a mesh wall covered in Skullwalltulas, just before the summit ledge, and you can bomb it to make it soar into the sky.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 065 - Frog Stage
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a stage for little musicians..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora River (Child Era): This rumor is located along the Zora River on the eastern side of Hyrule. Once in the region as a child, look to the north side of a large raised island to find a small grove where frogs gather to sing if you play your ocarina.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 066 - The Clear-Stream Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one listening carefully to the murmuring of a clear stream joyfully wobbles from side to side..." - Points: 20P - Location - Zora River: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, located along the Zora River on the eastern side of Hyrule. Once in the region, you can find this Gossip Stone atop a high platform off a large central island in the middle of the river. If exploring as a child, you can reach it by using a Cucco to float toward the back of the island and climb the vines to the top, where you can hit the Gossip Stone with your Slingshot.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 067 - The Grotto Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one who listens carefully to the sound of water running down bare rock joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora River: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone in a Hidden Hole, located along the Zora River on the eastern side of Hyrule. Once in the region, you'll need to climb to the top of the large central island in the river, and walk to the eastern side to find the grotto entrance, where you can perform Din's Fire to make the Gossip Stone spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 068 - The Waterfall Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one refusing sleep joyfully wobbles from side to side..." - Points: 20P - Location - Zora River: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, and is located along the Zora River on the eastern side of Hyrule. At the very end of the river where the large waterfall guards the entrance to Zora Domain, you can find this Gossip Stone at the bottom and hit it with your Slingshot.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 069 - The Reverberating Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one listening carefully to the murmuring of a clear streaming flowing from the depths of the earth joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora River: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, located along the Zora River on the eastern side of Hyrule. At the very start of this area, you can play the Song of Storms to reveal a Hidden Hole where the Gossip Stone is located, and plant a bomb to make it soar into the sky.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 070 - Before a Deity
description: - Rumor: "It seems there's a place for the Zora to offer prayers..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora Domain: This rumor can be found within the Zora home of Zora Domain beyond the waterfall of the Zora River. Once inside, follow the stone path and take a right beyond the stairs going up to where Zora are gathered in front of a small mural of Lord Jabu-Jabu.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 071 - Lucky Zora Fish
description: - Rumor: "Supposedly a fish created by the Zora princess exists somewhere in this world..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora Domain: This rumor can be found within the Zora home of Zora Domain beyond the waterfall of the Zora River. Once inside, follow the stone path and take a right beyond the stairs to find the entrance to the Zora Shop, where a large fish-shape sign is adorned at the top of the doorway.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 072 - Mocking Fishy Shadows
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a suspicious-looking Zora carrying a bottle..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora Domain (Child Era): This rumor can be found within the Zora home of Zora Domain beyond the waterfall of the Zora River. Once inside as a child, follow the stone path and take a right beyond the stairs to reach the bottom floor, where you'll find a shallow section of the water where a Zora tries to catch fresh fish around him.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 073 - The History Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one residing by the folk of the water joyfully bounces up and down..." - Points: 20P - Location - Zora Domain: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, and can be found within the Zora home of Zora Domain beyond the waterfall of the Zora River. Once inside, follow the stone path and take a left up the main staircase to reach King Zora's audience chamber, and you can attack the nearby Gossip Stone under the King with your sword to make it wobble.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 074 - Guardian of Water
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the symbol of the Zora tribe is displayed above the Zora king's head..." - Points: 30P - Location - Zora Domain: This rumor can be found within the Zora home of Zora Domain beyond the waterfall of the Zora River. Once inside, follow the stone path and take a left up the main staircase to reach King Zora's audience chamber, and you'll find the symbol just above him.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 075 - The Fountain Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one watching over the transience of a fountain joyfully spins and stretches..." - Points: 20P - Location - Zora Fountain: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, and can be found above the Zora Domain at the Zora Fountain where Lord Jabu-Jabu resides. Once you reach the fountain, look to the left of where Lord Jabu-Jabu resides to find a Gossip Stone you can burn with Din's Fire to make spin and stretch.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 076 - The Great Fairy Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one watching over the prospects of the Great Fairy joyfully wobbles from side to side..." - Points: 20P - Location - Zora Fountain: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, and can be found above the Zora Domain at the Zora Fountain where Lord Jabu-Jabu resides. Once you reach the fountain, head to the southern patch of land where the entrance to a Great Fairy Fountain is, and you can hit the Gossip Stone here with your Slingshot.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 078 - Ferryboat
description: - Rumor: "It is said that, somewhere in this world, there's a ship that never floats..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Swim to the Fishing Hole entrance on the eastern side to find a beached rowboat just outside.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 079 - A Big Bite
description: - Rumor: "Apparently, there's a fish with a mouth big enough to swallow a child..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Swim to the Fishing Hole entrance on the eastern side to find a large advertisement sign featuring a fish.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 080 - The Fish Guardians
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there are three fish that swim in the air..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor can be found in a fishing area on Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Swim to the Fishing Hole entrance on the eastern side and enter the area, looking along the northern edge of the pond by a stream trickling down from above to find three fish sculptures.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 081 - The Thing in the Tank
description: - Rumor: "It is said that there is a mysterious thing in a tank, and that thing has eight wriggling tentacles..." - Points: 30P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Enter the large Lakeside Laboratory overlooking the lake on the northwestern side to find a large tank holding an octopus within.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 084 - The Ripple Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one gazing at the ripples on the water's surface joyfully surrenders to the hammer..." - Points: 20P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, which can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Head to the large dead tree on the island in the center of the lake, where you'll find a Gossip Stone nestled along the southern side, and bash it with the Megaton Hammer.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 085 - The Aloof Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the aloof one that surrendered its body to the water joyfully bounces up and down..." - Points: 20P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, which can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Head to the small islands to the far southwest of the largest island with the dead tree to find this Gossip Stone, and hit it with your sword to make it bounce.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 086 - The Lake Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one watching over the lake joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 20P - Location - Lake Hylia: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone, which can be found along the waters of Lake Hylia, far past the southern point of Hyrule Field. Swim to the far southwestern shores of the lake to find a small wooded area with a Gossip Stone, and plant a bomb to send it soaring.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 087 - Li'l Miss Moo in the Valley
description: - Rumor: "A deep moo echoes through the valley. The source of that sound is..." - Points: 30P - Location - Gerudo Valley (Child Era): The location of this rumor can be found in the Gerudo Valley on the far west area past Hyrule Field. As a child, you can find a Cucco loitering by the bridge, and use it to float down to the bottom of the valley where a cow is being looked after by a Gerudo.

title: Gossip Quest Rumor 088 - The Valley-Crossing Watcher
description: - Rumor: "It is said that the one being washed away by a spray of water at the floor of a red valley joyfully jumps to the skies..." - Points: 20P - Location - Gerudo Valley: This rumor takes the form of a Gossip Stone that can be found in the Gerudo Valley on the far west area past Hyrule Field. To find it, you'll need to float or dive down to the bottom of the valley below and swim to the large alcove on the western side where a Gossip Stone is found by the falls, and use a bomb to send it soaring.

description: Location: Inside the storage area here with nine milk crates, and a large metal grate at the end. Pull out the closest crates to empty two spots in the middle column, and then pull back the crate in the middle against the wall. This will reveal a small gap you can crawl through. On the other side you'll find your first Piece of Heart! For every four pieces you find, you'll earn a new Heart Container to add to your total health!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Another early Heart Piece is found in Kakariko Village, off to the northeast of Hyrule. Once there, you can head up the stairs to the left and climb to the roof of a building near a large wooden tower, where you can spot a man on another rooftop nearby who has something for you, but getting to him can be tricky. Grab a nearby Cucco that's wandering around the path up to Death Mountain, and run over to the Windmill. From here, you can jump over the fence to the other side, where a ladder leads up to a hilltop behind the large windmill. When you grab the Cucco on top of the hill behind the Windmill, make sure to leap over to the roof of Granny's Potion Shop (the blue rooftop). Carefully move to the other side of the blue roof closer to the wooden tower, and you'll find the man lounging on the lower roof section. He'll be so happy someone's come to see him that he'll give you a Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Beyond the village of Kakariko past the Windmill is the town's graveyard. By night, Dampe the Gravedigger will wander the grounds, and offer Dampe's Heart-Poundin' Grave-Diggin' Tour! Request to play Dante's Grave-digging tour, and he'll reveal several dirt mounds all across the graveyard area. You can guide him to any of the dirt mounds and interact with them to pay Dampe 10 Rupees to dig in the spot. Whatever comes up is yours to keep... provided something is actually buried there. Sometimes you'll get a few Rupees, other times nothing at all, but keep at it until he detects something heavy and asks for another 5 Rupees to keep at it, as it contains his special prize: A Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Pull back the grave at the far southern edge of this same row below the royal tomb, and you'll find one more tomb to drop into. No enemies here, but a large Treasure Chest holds a Piece of Heart -- which should be the fourth one you've found to grant you an extra Heart Container! _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: When exploring Hyrule Castle Town, you'll run into a lady who's constantly doting on her little white dog named [Richard](https://mapgenie.io/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time/maps/child-past?locationIds=1063868). However, once you've opened up the gate leading to Death Mountain, you can return to the Castle Town to find out from her that Richard has gone missing, and you'll be tasked to find him amid all the other stray dogs that descend upon Castle Town in the evening. To find Richard, head down the alleyway past the Bomchu Shop near where the lady and her dog live. Richard should appear around the back corner, not far from the Treasure Chest Shop (there are a few other white dogs in other parts of the alley, so you may grab the wrong one and need a do-over). Interact with the dog to get it to follow you, then return to the lady. If it's the right dog, she'll be overjoyed and award you a Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once you reach Goron City, you'll be tasked to find a song to cheer up Darunia, which you can get by finding Saria in the Lost Wood's Sacred Grove. Once you have it, head back into the Lost Woods, and from the starting point, take a left. This leads to a small grove with a friendly Skull Kid playing on his flute. Step onto the smaller trunk, and play Saria's Song with him. Any friend of Saria's is a friend of his, and he'll reward this new bond with a new Piece of Heart for you!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once Saria has given you the Fairy Ocarina, you can enter the Lost Woods atop Kokiri Forest. From the entrance to the wooded maze, follow the music right to the east. This next area has a lower pathway where two more Skull Kids are playing their instruments on large tree trunks. Join with them using your Ocarina, and they'll start a game of "follow the tune". You'll need to repeat a randomized tune of notes that build from 3-5, and if you can follow along, they'll pass you a Blue Rupee. Try it again, and this time you'll have to follow the notes that build from 4-6. If you're having trouble as they hide which notes you need to memorize, look for the placement on the prompt to clue you in on which notes you need to remember. Complete this task, and you'll earn a Red Rupee worth 20. Play their game one last time for a super hard version of following notes that build from 6 to 8. If you can keep following along, you'll earn the ultimate prize: a new Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: In Goron City, there's a large Goron-shaped pot in the middle of the city at its bottom level. After meeting Darunia, you can light the torches around the pot using a lit Deku Stick, and the pot will begin to spin. Once you have the Bomb Bag from Dodongo Cavern, return to the spinning pot, and look for a plank that puts you close to the top of the pot. You'll want to toss a bomb into the spinning pot, ideally when the "Happy" face is facing you. The pot will spin wildly, and depending on the face it stops spinning on, you can earn different prizes. If it lands on the "Happy" face, you'll get a Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, there's two Pieces of Heart hiding in the extreme heat of the Death Mountain Crater. Be warned, after around 4 seconds, you'll start to take a quarter heart damage every second, so you'll need to move quickly. From the entrance, quickly dash down the slope and then to the right between two large rocks, and look for some mesh along the ground leading to a wall you can climb down the face of the inner volcano. Just below these two mesh spots is a Piece of Heart hiding in an alcove (which will also reset the time it takes to start taking damage), just be sure to quickly leap back up the mesh after claiming it!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, there's two Pieces of Heart hiding in the extreme heat of the Death Mountain Crater. Be warned, after around 4 seconds, you'll start to take a quarter heart damage every second, so you'll need to move quickly. Sprint down the slope from the entrance to the northwest to spot a low platform, near a broken bridge with a large grey rock in the way making it impossible to cross. What you can do from this side is find a Business Deku Scrub here -- of all places! He'll sell you another Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees. It's a steep price, but well worth it (and will reset the time until you start taking damage).

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, you can climb up the Death Mountain Trail to reach the top. Here, you'll find Kaepora Gaebora the Owl. He'll offer to give you a ride down to Kakariko Village, which you should accept and enjoy the flight! Kaepora Gaebora will drop you off on top of Impa's House of all places, but don't jump off just yet. Carefully move to the back of the rooftop, and look down for a small cow pen that's been hidden behind sealed gates. On the roof of the pen is a Piece of Heart that can't be accessed except from this roof, so hop down onto the lower roof of the cow pen and claim your prize! If exploring the area as an adult, you can use your Hookshot gained from the Graveyard on the bright green vines to the left of Impa's House to get over the fence. _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once you've completed the Dodongo's Cavern dungeons and open up supply lines from the Gorons back to the townsfolk of Hyrule Castle Town, you'll have access to the Bombchu Bowling Alley near the center of town. For the cost of 10 Rupees, you can try your hand at navigating Bombchus into a target on a far wall, avoiding obstacles and banking them off walls to reach 3 goals with 10 Bombchus. It'll take a bit of practice and angling, but there are some wonderful prizes to earn as you unlock harder courses: - Beginner Course: 10 Bombchus - Advanced Course: Biggest Bomb Bag - Expert Course: Piece of Heart For the harder courses, we recommend looking for a way to angle the Bombchus off the wall at angles to reach the back, or look for the small gaps between obstacles to drive a straight path through threading anything in the way -- timing is crucial!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: There is no way to reach this Piece of Heart without some extra help. To get it, head to the southern part of the island and across to a high ledge that hides a [Grotto](https://mapgenie.io/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time/maps/child-past?locationIds=1064593) entrance. In here, you'll find another [Cucco](https://mapgenie.io/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time/maps/child-past?locationIds=1064596). Grab the Cucco and take him with you as you exit the Grotto, and then cross to the narrow platform where a Sheikah Stone is. From here, leap down to the Heart Piece using the second Cucco to float across! _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Once you have access to a bomb bag, you can begin to explore Zora River, and you'll find a Cucco wandering around on the other side of a sealed gate past a Bean Seller. Be sure to take the Cucco with you as you continue up the Zora River trail to where the entrance to Zora's Domain is. There are several crossing platforms here. On the other side, a high ledge overlooks a second Piece of Heart on a tiny platform to the northwest. Use that Cucco you held earlier to do one more floating jump across the falls to reach it. _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Upon reaching Zora's Domain, there's a secret Piece of Heart you can reveal by solving a little puzzle. Head up to the Audience Chamber in front of King Zora, and look around, noting the two lit torches at the entrance to the audience chamber. You can use a Deku Stick and run down the steps to light torches along the way. Keep running between torches and then stowing your stick before taking it out again as you head down to the bottom level, and follow a path behind the large waterfall to find two final braziers to light, which will reveal a Treasure Chest in the middle holding a Piece of Heart. _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: When in Lake Hylia, you can visit a small area across the water from the two scarecrows to find Lake Hylia's own Fishing Pond. It's here you can rent out a fishing rod and try your luck and land a big haul! The set-up is pretty straightforward: try to find a big-looking fish in the middle of the pod, cast your line near it, then gently pull back with ZR and wiggle your line to get its attention. When it does, you'll need to alternate holding left or right -- whichever direction the fish is trying to flee in, until it gets tired and stops for a moment. When it does, hold down ZR and keep reeling in until it resumes its frantic escape. Keep it up, and the fish will be yours. The owner is pretty good at judging the size at a distance, and if you bring him anything over 50cm, you'll be awarded a Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Though much of Gerudo Valley is inaccessible to Child Link, there are still two Pieces of Heart you can locate fairly early (or come back as an adult). Though the bridge gate is closed, there are sections of the valley wall you can jump to, and along the opposite side you can spy a large Treasure Chest. The gap is normally too big to cross, but there happens to be a Cucco nearby that you can grab and float across the valley to the other side. Open the Treasure Chest, and you'll find a Piece of Heart inside! _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: Look for a Cucco wandering near the bridge, and use it to carefully float down to the large alcove at the bottom of the valley with the raging river below that feeds out to Lake Hylia. Jump off with the Cucco and slowly float down to a large alcove along the waterline. Head up this large alcove path up north toward the giant waterfall. You'll find there's actually a path behind the waterfall, and you can climb it to reach another Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: If you travel toward the entrance to Gerudo Valley, look under a large rock outcropping and you'll find a small Treasure Chest. However, as a child, there seems to be no way to unlock it. To find a way to unlock it, you'll need to become Adult Link. Return to inspect the Treasure Chest in the future to find fairy writing nearby, urging you specifically to take what's inside before someone else does. Unfortunately, someone else already has. After completing the Forest Temple, you can then return to being Child Link, and head back to find the Treasure Chest can now be opened to nab a Piece of Heart!

title: Heart Piece
description: Location: If you look just to the east of Hyrule Castle Town's gate along the moat, you can find a cracked stone that you can bomb revealing a Grotto entrance. Inside is a peculiar Deku Business Scrub, who won't trade with you unless you know the password. To get the password, you'll have to become Adult Link, and return to the Grotto entrance. Nearby on a tree, you can now find fairy writing which has the password. Unfortunately, as an adult, the Scrub has already sold his wares. Once you complete the Forest Temple, return to being Child Link, and use the password on the Scrub to buy his Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees! The right choice is: Sell somethin', will ya?"

title: Heart Piece
description: Required: Song of Storms Location: After using the Ocarina to learn the Song of Storms from the Windmill Man as Adult Link in Kakariko Village, return to the past. As Young Link, head to Zora River to speak with the frogs, and play the Song of Storms. They'll be delighted for the rainfall, and award you a Piece of Heart.

title: Heart Piece
description: Required: Learned all six non-teleport songs (Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Time and the Song of Storms) Location: After you've played all six non-teleport songs for the group of frogs along Zora River, speak with the group again to play a minigame with them. They'll ask you to play the right tune matching the fly hovering over each frog. Play the sequence quickly, and you can earn a Piece of Heart. Solution: L, Y, A, R, Y, A, R, L, R, L, R, A, Y, L

title: Heart Piece
description: Turn in 50 tokens at the Cursed Spider House Location: To get this Piece of Heart, you'll need to have done your job hunting down Gold Skulltulas across Hyrule. You can follow our guide to claim the tokens as you progress through the game, which should get you to the 50 mark around the time you complete the Forest Temple. Once you have at least 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens, return to the Cursed Spider House in Kakariko Village, and talk to the father to get your reward. _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Heart Piece
description: Required: Lenses of Truth Location: After learning the Song of Storms from the Windmill Man as an adult, and playing it for him as a child, you'll be able to access the mini-dungeon at the Bottom of the Well, where you can uncover the Lenses of Truth item to see the contents of chests before you open them. Use this by returning to Castle Town and playing the Treasure Chest game, using the Lenses to locate all the keys to the next room to claim your prize—a Piece of Heart.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: This Gold Skulltula is located on the top Floor 3F of the dungeon, found in the room with the Compass. You'll need to step on the small stone switch to raise up three platforms in the middle of the room, but instead of cross, stick to the left side of the middle platform. Defeat the Skulltula blocking a high ledge, then jump up to find the Gold Skulltula against the wall at your height.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: This one can be found as soon as you reach the top of the dungeon and jump down to create a hole to the basement by destroying the webbing in the center of the room. As you swim out of the pool of water, be sure to turn around. There's a large vine wall leading back up to the first floor in case you need to get back, but more importantly is a Gold Skulltula. You can defeat it with your slingshot, and then climb up to retrieve the token.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: This one can be found as soon as you reach the top of the dungeon and jump down to create a hole to the basement by destroying the webbing in the center of the room, and is located in the same area as the previous Gold Skulltula. As you drop down near the large dividing pool of water, check the northern side to find a large grate where a third Gold Skulltula is hiding. You can shoot it from afar with your Slingshot, and then leap to the grate to claim the token.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: To reach it, you'll need to make your way through the passageways in the northwest, located west of the webbed hole leading down to the boss arena on B2. The room the Gold Skultulla is hiding in is the one where three Gohma Larva will fall down from the ceiling. Once defeated, note the webbing in the top northwest corner of the room. Use the nearby lit torch to light up a Deku Stick so you can burn the webbing away, and defeat the Deku Baba and regular Skulltula guarding the path to the final Gold Skultulla of this dungeon. It's sitting high on some vines at the back of the room, and you can slingshot it before climbing up to get the token.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: As soon as you enter Hyrule Field for the first time, there are already two Gold Skulltulas that you can track down, if you know where to look. One is hidden in a tree on the eastern side of Hyrule Field, not far from the entrance to the Kokiri Forest. Cross the small stream to reach it, and then roll into the tree, and a Gold Skulltula will fall out. _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: While the Hyrule Castle Town is a fairly busy area, you can actually find a Gold Skulltula hiding in the town as soon as you enter from Hyrule Field. Start by taking an immediate right into a room by the castle town gate, and you'll find an armory room littered with pots and crates, and one very bored guardsman. Roll into the large crates by the guard at the far end of the room to find one is hiding a Gold Skultulla, which you can kill and claim its token.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: To reach it, you'll need to make your way past the initial group of guards by the front gate, which means climbing up and over the gatehouse, and jumping down into the gardens. From here, dart between the hedges by taking the middle path, and then hang around the outside to climb up the western wall to bypass the large locked gate. Look for a small enclosed area to the right of the vine wall leading up to the moat for some barrels and sacks, and a lone tall and narrow tree. Roll into it, and you'll dislodge a Gold Skulltula from its hiding place!

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: As you enter the ranch, be sure to check around the northeast side of the ranch, behind the main house Talon is in. There's a small yard area with a wooden tower, and two trees. Roll into the tall and narrow tree, and you can dislodge a Gold Skulltula here! _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One Gold Skulltula is hiding atop the main tall tree at the entrance to the village, where the Master Craftsman yells at his workers all day (and where his son slinks out to and rests at night). Roll into the tree to dislodge the spider and claim its token.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One can be found by simply walking outside the Cursed Spider House and waiting for nightfall. A small golden spiderweb just to the left of the door is its hiding spot, where the Gold Skulltula will appear only at night!

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once night has fallen in Kakariko Village, inspect the building under construction on the south side of the village, near the Cucco Lady, and you'll find a Gold Skulltula on a high ledge of the red brick wall, and you can use the scaffolding to reach it.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Another Gold Skulltula similarly only appears at night in Kakariko Village, and can be found along the ladder of the tall wooden tower in the center of town, along the pathway up to the Gate to Death Mountain. Hit it with your slingshot and then climb up to retrieve the token. Requires: Slingshot

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Another Gold Skulltula in Kakariko Village is hiding out of view, and likewise only appears at night. To the south of the wooden tower and Potion Shop is another building where a little boy lives (usually out playing in the graveyard), and if you circle around the back of the house, you can find a Gold Skulltula in its web along the building wall.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: There are two Gold Skulltulas in the Graveyard beyond Kakariko Village, but one can be reached earlier than the other as a child. You can head up the steps on the left side to find a plot of soft soil on the other side of a small tree. Drop a Bug from your bottle (if you don't have one, look under the stones at the Graveyard entrance), and it will fish out a Gold Skulltula for you to defeat! Requires: Bug (Bottled)

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once you've obtained an Empty Bottle and place a bug in it, return to Kokiri Forest. Look around the back of the Kokiri Shop, and you should be able to spot a patch of soft soil. Plant a bug in it, and a Gold Skulltula will jump out for you to slay. Requires: Bug (Bottled)

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: While you can't find this Gold Skultula when your adventure first starts, you can return here after meeting Princess Zelda and the time of day begins to change from day to night. Use the Sun's Song (or sleep in Link's bed) to make sure it's nightfall in the forest, and then check around the back of the Home of the Know-It-All Brothers by the Training Grounds. It's here you'll find a new Skulltulla hiding along the treehouse wall.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Upon entering the Lost Woods with a Bug in a bottle, take a left as soon as you enter. From this grove with the solitary Skull Kid, be sure to move south through a nearby tunnel. It will take you to a high ledge overlooking the bridge leading out of Kokiri Forest, and you can find some soft soil here. Drop a bug in, and out will pop another Gold Skulltulla to defeat. Requires: Bug (Bottled)

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Upon entering the Lost Woods with a Bug in a bottle, take the path to where the shortcut to Goron City is. Head right to the pool of water, then left going north, and take another left. This will lead you to a smaller meadow teeming with several Business Scrubs. On the side near a large tree is some soft soil, which you can again drop a Bug into (one of the scrubs actually sells Bugs!) to reveal the last Gold Skulltula that you can get for now in this area. Requires: Bug (Bottled)

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once you have obtained the Goron Bracelet from Daruina in Goron City, you'll be able to pick up and throw Bomb Flowers. Exit Goron City back onto the Death Mountain Trail. Head over to the Goron babysitting the lone Bomb Flower, and try grabbing it. You can then toss it over the ledge and down toward the large cracked boulder blocking the entrance to Dodongo Cavern, which will explode to reveal its entrance! Note the patch of soft soil just inside the tunnel, and drop a Bug inside to scare out a Gold Skulltula that you can defeat for a token. Requires: Goron Bracelet, Bug (Bottled)

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, this one can be found in the first hallway leading east from the main entrance hall with the giant skull. Near the back of the hall where three Baby Dodongos emerge is a large cracked wall. While there are no Bomb Flowers around, you can either lure the exploding enemies near the wall, or come back with bombs when you have them. Behind the cracked wall is a Gold Skulltula flanked by a few Keese waiting to ambush you. Requires: Goron Bracelet or Bombs _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, this one can be found on the northwestern side of the first floor, off the main entrance room with the large skull, Make your way north to an area with a large raised staircase high above you. There are Bomb Flowers all around its base, with a small gap near the front. Look for a separate Bomb Flower away from the rest, and place it in the small gap so you can unleash one continuous explosion setting off all the bombs in a chain around the stairs. This will erode the structure, causing it to sink into the ground, and make the large staircase accessible to climb up. Head up from the large stairs to the higher level on the south side of the room, but be sure to turn around before you reach the exit. There's a large mesh wall here, with a Gold Skulltula hanging from the side among some Skullwalltulas. Hit them with slingshots, then climb up the mesh to grab your token. Requires: Goron Bracelet, Slingshot _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, you can find this one on the second floor of the large entrance hall, just after acquiring a Bomb Bag and some Bombs. At the far northeast corner of this area by the giant skull, there's another cracked wall you can detonate with a bomb. This will reveal a room with two Dodongos pacing around a large rock in the middle of the room, and on the other side you'll find a Gold Skulltula hiding (which can be killed by a detonating Dodongo!). Requires: Bombs _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, you'll find this spider after you have unlocked the secret passage through the giant skull by dropping bombs in the eye sockets. Head through to a room with several narrow pathways and stone blocks to push around and drop. After pushing the block down to the lower level, be sure and push the fallen block all the way to the far wall, where there's a ledge with a large cracked wall. Toss a bomb on top of the stone block to blast apart the wall, then climb up to find a small room. There are several Baby Dodongos waiting to ambush you, and near the back you'll find a Gold Skulltula hiding behind an Armos statue, which you can also toss a bomb at to detonate them both (or lure the Baby Dodongos into)! Requires: Bombs _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After you have acquired the Bomb Bag from Dodongo Cavern, return to the start of the Death Mountain Trail. Just after rounding the corner from the path to Kakariko Village, look for a cracked stone wall by the Red Tektites. You can blow up the wall, and even if it's not nightfall, a Gold Skulltula can be found on the other side for you to defeat. Requires: Bombs _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Required: Bombs Location: After getting the Bomb Bag, return to Goron City. On the entrance tier, head along to the upper left side and blast through the boulders to find a room full of brown and gray rocks, as well as strange black obelisks. You can bomb a path through the cracked boulders heading right, then left, then straight to find two Treasure Chests with a Blue Rupee apiece, and a crate hiding a Gold Skulltula!

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, there's a Gold Skulltula hiding in the extreme heat of the Death Mountain Crater. Be warned, after around 4 seconds, you'll start to take a quarter heart damage every second, so you'll need to move quickly. Since you'll want to move quickly here, focus on running forward and look for two wooden crates by a pot on the left side. Roll into the furthest crate to find a Gold Skulltula hiding inside.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: On the southern side of Hyrule Field, look for a large wooded area south of Lon Lon Ranch. Over by a large Peahat, there's a crack on the ground you can use a bomb on to reveal a Grotto. Inside the Grotto, you can find another Gold Skulltula to defeat. Requires: Bombs and Boomerang _This can also be done as adult Link!_

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Required: Bombs, Bug (Bottled) Location: The Magic Bean Seller will sell you Magic Beans, which can be planted in the soft soil you can also find Gold Skulltulas in. One such patch of soft soil is right next to the Bean Seller, and so you can lure out a Gold Skulltula here by dropping a Bug into the soil.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Required: Bombs Location: Head all the way up the river path to the hidden entrance to Zora's Domain behind a large waterfall. While inspecting the area around the falls, you can jump down at the base of the falls, and there's vines near a central platform to take you back up. Be sure to stick around this area at night, as a Gold Skulltula will appear around the backside of where the vines are for you to defeat.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Lake Hylia region to the south of Hyrule Field, you can find this one by the large observatory building. Outside, you can find a patch of soft soil, so be sure to send a Bug from a bottle in to scare up a Gold Skulltula. Requires: Bug (Bottled)

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Lake Hylia region to the south of Hyrule Field, this spider is in a location exclusive to the remake of Ocarina of Time, located at the far edge of the lake. From the large island with the huge tree and pedestal, start swimming for the far shores to the southwest. Along the southern tip, look for the smallest of ledges you can climb up to find a tunnel entrance. You can shuffle through to the other side, where you'll find a Gold Skulltula.

title: Gold Skulltula
description: Location: After you've found the Empty Bottle in Lake Hylia with a note from Princess Ruto, you can show it to King Zora to be granted access to where Lord Jabu Jabu is at the Zora Fountain. Off to the south, you can find a shallow path leading to a section of land with a few trees and a large cracked wall. Be sure to try rolling into the narrow tall tree here, and you can dislodge a Gold Skulltula!

title: Gold Skulltula

title: Gohma
description: How to Defeat: As she approaches, Gohma will cover her eyes with the mandibles above her face, and block any incoming attacks. Soon she will prepare to strike, raising its mandibles and two large forward claws. That's your cue to backflip away from the danger before Gohma slams forward. After a few strikes, Gohma will decide to change things up, and retreat away from you, and start climbing up the walls! Watch it carefully, as soon after reaching the ceiling, Gohma's eye will turn green again. You need to be quick to react, and pull out your Fairy Slingshot to hit it with projectiles from afar while she remains out of reach. Hitting its eye with your slingshot will cause Gohma to become stunned, crashing down to the ground and becoming dizzy for several moments. That's your cue to run in and start slashing with quick hits or jump attacks to deal as much damage as you can before Gohma can right herself and flee once more.

title: King Dodongo
description: How to Defeat: You can either pull out a bomb to throw, or look for Bomb Flowers that have sprouted up along each of the four paths ringing the lava -- one should be just to your left. Toss the bomb before he finishes readying his fire blast, and it will detonate inside his mouth, stunning King Dodongo. This will be your chance to press your assault on his vulnerable tongue while it hangs open. Get in some quick stabs or a jump attack until he wakes up and readies his next move. After taking damage, King Dodongo will respond by rolling into a ball and careening forward along the narrow paths like an unstoppable rolling death machine. The path is too narrow for you to sidestep around him without stepping into the lava, so instead you'll want to start retreating back. You'll find that each corner of the room has some extra space out by the lava, and you can let King Dodongo slam into a wall and turn down the next path while you wait on the inside of the corner turn.

title: Barinade
description: How to defeat: As long as those lightning emitters are active, you'll want to constantly be moving, strafing the strange creature and dodging the lightning blasts they'll send your way regularly. Your first order of business should be finding a way to reveal Barinade's vulnerabilities. The tethers keeping the creature to the ceiling all have frayed points along the top, and you can alternate between the three tethers to toss your Boomerang at while strafing, taking them out one at a time while evading incoming lightning blasts. Once Barinade is completely untethered from the ceiling, phase two will begin. Barinade will dislodge the electric jellyfish guarding its body, and send them spinning around in front as a moving electrified shield. You don't want to come into contact with this offensive shield, so keep your distance as it starts to move around the arena. If you watch, the extended output will make Barinade's core burn brightly, until eventually it shorts out. This will cause the shields to be removed for a moment, leaving the jellyfish it used as a barrier to become defenseless. Waste no time in charging in to slice apart as many blobby creatures as you can to diminish its barrier, before Barinade can restart its power.

description: On the back of the stone arch. "Nobody should EVER, I mean NEVER EVER, point a stick in the direction of a butterfly! And they'd better NEVER point a stick at a butterfly and stand still while they're doing it." This hint lets you summon a fairy with a stick to heal Link.

title: Fairy Thought
description: Location: On the back wall of the house. "That kid's song is nice to listen to, huh? I hear all the moo cows are horns over hooves for it!" This hints at being able to get Lon Lon Milk by playing Epona's Song to them.

title: Fairy Thought
description: "I bet when somebody shakes a tree, and something falls out, they'll think it's a coincidence. But I put it there! I'm such a sneak."

title: Fairy Thought
description: "I bet the twitchy one living in the dirt would be good friends with the skittish one under the rock, if they met!"

title: Fairy Thought
description: "I love to make pretty rupee arrangements! Most especially when I put them floating inside of puddles or down inside holes in the ground... I don't mind if somebody takes them after I've made my arrangement. I had my fun with the rupees, so let someone else enjoy them!"

title: Fairy Thought
description: Written on the side of a broken column, on the right side of the room where the Sun's Song is learned. Play the Sun's Song in front of it and it'll restore lost hearts. "I forget how that song went. The one carved in the stone monument. I'd love to hear it again. If only to jog my memory."

title: Fairy Thought
description: "When it comes to the best sneaky spots for a game of hide-and-seek, you just can't beat someplace like this! At the very least, the other fairies shouldn't be able to break it open or toss it around!"

title: Fairy Thought
description: Location: Inside sarcophagus. Burn spider web to open. "I sort of miss hearing that old guy sing about 'round and 'round. But he's so far away! I wish someone around here knew his song so I could hear it right now." This hints that playing the Song of Storms here (learned from the Music Man at the Windmill) will restore some of Link's health.

title: Fairy Thought
description: "Those big Peahats are darn scary. They put down roots and act like they own Hyrule Field! But I heard they're no different than other plants when it comes to fire! Lucky thing I learned that!"

title: Fairy Thought
description: On cart beside the road. Suggests that there are bugs in nearby plants. "I know what you're thinking! You're the only one here. Just you and some weeds, huh? Wrong! Take a closer look, and you'll find little ones skittering about!"

title: Fairy Thought
description: On the back side of the stone building, outside of the fenced ranch area. Play the Sun's Song and a fairy will appear and replenish lost hearts. "I just love the view of Hyrule Field from here. Day or night, it's gorgeous, isn't it? Wouldn't it be nifty if you could switch back and forth between them, over and over?"

title: Fairy Thought
description: "I do love the scenery out here, but I have to be honest... The air here is SO. HORRIBLY. DRY. I wish it would rain." Play the Song of Storms to restore Link's hearts and magic meter.

title: Fairy Thought
description: Written on the outside of the tomb. "I ended up down in the depths of a tomb, and a terrifying monster showed up out of nowhere! I started to sing my glowing little heart out, and it stopped chasing me! Now, if I could just remember the name of the song..."

title: Fairy Thought
description: On the rock by the water and the castle wall. "This is it! The BEST idea I've ever had! Nobody will EVER suspect I've hidden my ENTIRE fortune in this wooden box! Ha! I'm a GENIUS!" It refers to the crate nearby. It contains the fortune of one Green Rupee.
